title: More Ready-made Sitemap Starters
description: Create private starter drafts for recent posts, summaries, combined content, grouped posts, child Pages, and other common sitemap layouts. Nothing is published automatically.

title: More Precise Content Directories
description: Choose a specific term in Grouped Sitemap, apply different query and sorting rules to each tab, and optionally respect SEO noindex and current-language rules.

title: WooCommerce Product Directories
description: Build product sitemaps by category, sale status, stock status, or featured status, with optional images, prices, descriptions, SKUs, and stock labels.

title: Consistent Child Page Thumbnails
description: Child Pages thumbnails now use exact square frames without stretching, including older non-square images and themes with broad featured-image styles.

title: Consistent Sitemap Spacing
description: Set Compact, Comfortable, or Custom item and nested-level spacing globally, then override it for an individual block or shortcode when needed. Child Pages can also show its linked parent as the root.

title: Clearer Child Page Sitemaps
description: Add optional separator lines and compact featured-image thumbnails to licensed Child Pages sitemaps, including the established [simple-sitemap-child] workflow.

title: A New Simple Sitemap Home
description: Create a sitemap draft, follow the visual Quick Start, explore Free actions, jump to matching live examples, and share feedback from one focused dashboard.

title: Explore the Complete Pro Toolkit
description: Licensed installs now show one comprehensive feature explorer with Pro-appropriate support, documentation, changelog, and direct live-example links.

title: Include and Exclude Filters in Free
description: Choose exact post or page IDs to include, or leave individual items out, directly from the Simple Sitemap block or shortcode.

title: Quick Start and Starter Patterns
description: Create a sitemap page from three ready-made patterns, with clearer setup guidance and transparent Free and Pro feature descriptions.

title: WooCommerce Product Sitemaps
description: Create bounded product lists or category-grouped product sitemaps with stock, featured-product, price, SKU, excerpt, and image controls.

title: Modern WordPress Compatibility
description: Simple Sitemap now uses Block API v3 for the current iframed WordPress editor, with improved accessibility, safer output, and more reliable controls.

title: More Sitemap Formats with Pro
description: Build taxonomy, navigation menu, archive, product, and hierarchical child-content sitemaps, with per-section, SEO, language, layout, and filtering controls.

title: Custom Post Type Labels
description: You can now edit the title labels for a post type via the sitemap block settings.

title: Exclude Child Pages
description: Use the new exclude_child shortcode attribute to optionally exclude the child pages of a specific page, that has been excluded from the sitemap.

title: New Default Settings
description: The post_type_label_font_size and sitemap_container_margin attributes in the sitemap blocks/shortcodes are now set to empty strings by default to blend in better with the current active WordPress theme.

title: New Sort Options
description: New sort options (Random Order, Menu Order, Comment Count) have been added to the Orderby attribute for the main sitemap block and shortcode.

title: New Shortcode Attribute
description: Added a new num_terms attribute to the [simple-sitemap-group] shortcode to limit the number of taxonomy terms displayed.

title: Preview Sitemap Blocks
description: Added support for block previews in the editor for sitemap and sitemap group blocks, when browsing blocks.
